description: This file defines internal interfaces for Orleans grain directory partitions and clients, including methods for registration, lookup, deregistration, snapshot retrieval, and test hooks.

classes.name: IGrainDirectoryPartition
classes.description: Interface for managing grain directory partitions, including registration, lookup, deregistration, snapshot handling, and snapshot acknowledgment.

classes.name: IGrainDirectoryClient
classes.description: Interface for clients to interact with grain directory, including obtaining and recovering registered activations.

classes.name: IGrainDirectoryTestHooks
classes.description: Interface providing test hooks for grain directory, such as integrity checks.

methods.name: RegisterAsync
methods.description: Registers a grain address with the specified membership version, returning the result.

methods.name: LookupAsync
methods.description: Looks up a grain address by grain ID with the specified version.

methods.name: DeregisterAsync
methods.description: Deregisters a grain address with the specified version.

methods.name: GetSnapshotAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a snapshot of the grain directory partition.

methods.name: AcknowledgeSnapshotTransferAsync
methods.description: Acknowledges the transfer of a snapshot to a silo.

methods.name: GetRegisteredActivations
methods.description: Retrieves all registered activations within a range.

methods.name: RecoverRegisteredActivations
methods.description: Recovers registered activations, possibly after failure or restart.

methods.name: CheckIntegrityAsync
methods.description: Performs an integrity check of the grain directory.
